# Honey Oat Flapjacks

Uses honey from our own hives.

- 250 g rolled oats
- 125 g butter
- 100 g light brown sugar
- 3 tbsp honey

Melt the butter, sugar and honey, stir in the oats, press into a lined tin and bake at 180 C for 20 minutes. Cut into squares while warm.
